description: Founded and led Bread Financial's Platform Engineering function, scaling it from a 3-team pilot into a lasting organization. Set the vision and built the cross-functional team behind the company's AI-driven software development lifecycle (AIDLC) initiative, delivering its first working proof of concept. Modernized CI/CD pipelines and reduced the enterprise defect backlog 51% year over year.

Promoted from Director, Engineering within the same team. Drove additional availability gains through blue-green deployments, horizontal scaling, and database connection pool optimization. Retired 125+ servers for $1.5M+ in annual savings through an evergreen API optimization program, and established end-to-end monitoring and alerting between Azure and ServiceNow to improve MTTR.

Built and led the Customer/Account engineering domain behind Bread Financial's Azure-based servicing APIs. Stabilized systems following the company's largest mainframe-to-cloud migration and cut Fiserv transaction volume 20-25% through API caching and circuit breakers.

Promoted from Senior Manager, Applications to lead the company's full Digital Technology Office across Web, Mobile, and Salesforce engineering. Directed digital delivery for the NFL and AAA partner launches and the company's first American Express card program. Delivered the Account Center Redesign, Universal Authentication, and Mobile First programs.

Led an $8M Salesforce and Mobile applications portfolio of 56 associates. Doubled mobile adoption while cutting go-to-market time from 7 months to 7 weeks. Led IT delivery of PartnerPortal, growing adoption to over 100 active brands.

Led a $7.6M Identity Management and Mobile applications portfolio across 2 agile teams and 32 associates. Spearheaded a $3.5M multi-factor authentication rollout securing 1.5M+ online accounts and directed a responsive redesign of Nationwide.com that grew site traffic 25%. Built a university hiring partnership with Bowling Green State University that became a company standard.

Managed a $1.68M application portfolio and a team of 10 developers supporting web and mainframe systems for Nationwide's broker-dealer business, leading the transition of application support to a newly built local team.

role: Programmer Analyst, Specialist & Consultant, IT Architecture
description: Progressed through 3 roles over 9 years supporting Nationwide's retirement plans technology, building the technical foundation for a two-decade engineering career.
